description: Use when an agent tracks stablecoin liquidity (mints/burns) as a market signal. Input: optional chain (all, ethereum, base), symbol (USDC). Output: JSON per token and chain totalSupply read onchain, change 24 h / 7 d (absolute and %), per-symbol sums, USD net change and direction, biggest movers, block numbers; peg=true adds Chainlink price, deviation bp and depeg status. Ethereum + Base only. Example: ?chain=all&peg=true Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

peg.description: true adds peg rows: Chainlink price, deviation in bp vs $1 (EURC vs EUR/USD), feed age, ok/watch/depeg/stale

symbol.description: Only this stablecoin (USDT, USDC, USDS, DAI, USDe, PYUSD, FDUSD, RLUSD, USD1, EURC)

name: crypto_stablecoins
title: Stablecoin supply and peg onchain: USDT, USDC, USDS, DAI, USDe, PYUSD on Ethereum and Base, 24 h / 7 d mint-burn
